title: Orbital second source (PubChemQC B3LYP/6-31G*//PM6, CC BY 4.0): bounded harvest, unit audit and cross-level calibration
question: Can a second, redistributable HOMO/LUMO source extend and calibrate the Week-17 orbit channel without touching the primary Batt-P30K values?

source.origin_level_evidence: dataset card + RIKEN PubChemQC B3LYP/6-31G* page

primary_source_unchanged.rule: the second source never overwrites HOMO_eV/LUMO_eV in data/processed/four_core_key_registry.csv

sampling.cid_to_key_resolution: PubChem PUG-REST listkey POST (comma-separated inchikey parameter); every candidate CID is re-verified by RDKit InChIKey equality against the record's pubchem-inchi

unit_hypothesis.claim: energy-alpha-homo/lumo/gap and orbital-energies carry eV, not hartree; the dataset card's 'hartree' annotation for orbital-energies is a documentation defect
unit_hypothesis.why: a valence HOMO of a neutral closed-shell organic molecule cannot sit at -4.6 hartree (~ -125 eV); the array element equals the eV-labelled scalar field exactly
unit_hypothesis.test: orbital-energies[0][homos[0]] == energy-alpha-homo and gap == lumo - homo, both to <= 1e-9 relative

judgements.A_shard_structure: cid is monotone increasing across the shard and the five structure probes return increasing cid windows; otherwise abort
judgements.B_unit_audit: the unit test passes for >= 95% of audited records (>= 40 records); record the pass rate verbatim
judgements.C_second_source_coverage: epsilon-roster hits >= 40 and viscosity-sample hits >= 100, else this arm reports reconnaissance only and publishes no layer
judgements.D_calibration_min_n: a linear cross-level fit is only reported when >= 60 paired (PubChemQC, Batt-P30K) molecules exist
judgements.E_calibration_quality: out-of-sample 2-fold MAE <= 0.35 eV and Pearson r >= 0.80 to label calibrated values usable_with_flag; otherwise reference_only
judgements.F_primary_untouched: Batt-P30K remains the orbit channel primary; second-source values are additive only
judgements.G_reaxys_excluded: no Reaxys-derived number may enter this layer
judgements.H_structure_identity: a hit counts only when the record's RDKit InChIKey equals the target key; otherwise it is logged as structure_mismatch

expected_failure_modes: level offset between gas-phase B3LYP/6-31G* and implicit-solvent wB97X-V/def2-TZVPPD is large and molecule-dependent
CID-to-key resolution may miss exotic fluorinated electrolytes that never entered PubChem
shard 0 only covers PubChem CIDs <= ~253696, so higher-CID electrolytes are out of reach in this arm
